source_lines.33: Assume Countable Choice. Let $U_h$ be a finite-dimensional cellwise-constant control space with nonempty box $Q_h$, and restrict the exact reduced objective $\widehat J$ of [[def-linear-elliptic-pde-constrained-control-problem]] to $Q_h$. Let $q_h^*$ be its minimizer and let $L_h\ge\|S|_{U_h}\|^2+\alpha$, where $S$ is the linear part of the continuous state-to-observation map and $\alpha>0$. Assume the residual- and projection-evaluation routines satisfy the finite-return admissibility conditions in [[alg-fem-control-proximal-gradient-certified-residual]]. Then that finite-budget algorithm terminates in finite time after at most $N$ iterations and at most $N$ calls to each routine, returning \texttt{inconclusive}, \texttt{budget-exhausted}, or \texttt{certified}. Every \texttt{certified} return at $q\in Q_h$ with reported bound $\rho=\tilde\rho+\delta/L_h$ satisfies $\|q-P_{Q_h}(q-\nabla\widehat J(q)/L_h)\|_U\le\rho\le\tau$, and consequently $\|q-q_h^*\|_U\le(L_h/\alpha)\rho=(L_h/\alpha)\tilde\rho+\delta/\alpha$. This bounds distance to the control-mesh minimizer of the exact PDE objective; it is not an error estimate between that minimizer and the unrestricted PDE optimum.
